valuation_methodology.owner_cash_definition: Pre-production developer: no normalized owner cash. Lawrence base uses scenario payoffs on probability-weighted project NAV plus marked uranium inventory, minus net debt and future dilution.
valuation_methodology.decision_rule: Keep marked uranium inventory, Wheeler River Phoenix/Gryphon options, and exploration portfolio separate from corporate burn. Do not capitalize feasibility-study NPV at 100% without probability and timing discounts.
